en: Soldier: head yellow, elongate and roughly rectangular, the sides nearly parallel. Labrum semicircular with long marginal setae. Mandibles long and sabre-shaped, only weakly curved, each inner margin bearing a small triangular tooth and a basal notch. Antennae with the third segment slender, the fourth short. Pronotum saddle-shaped, its anterior margin shallowly incised. Alate: body brown, wings with the median vein unbranched and the cubitus divided into many branches. The species is recorded from southern China, where colonies inhabit dead wood and old stumps; details of the biology remain poorly known.
soldier: 头部呈红棕色，头的前缘连同触角窝盖片为赤褐色，上唇棕黄，上颚几近黑色。触角本身淡黄，自第三节起，各节后半段转为淡棕至褐色，节与节之间因而界线分明。前胸背板淡赤棕色，腿节淡黄，胫节与跗节淡黄棕，腹部淡黄白。头部被毛稍多，囟区四周生有数根长刚毛，唇基毛稀疏，上唇前缘共十二根毛，前胸背板背面也被毛稍多。
